app.title: Multi-Junction RT-PCR Primer Designer
app.summary: A person pastes a genomic sequence with exons in uppercase and introns in lowercase, and sets limits on primer length, melting temperature and product size. One button finds every exon-exon junction and designs candidate primer pairs whose product spans each junction. All pairs from all junctions are ranked in one table. The best pair is shown as a recommendation with dimer-risk flags and can be downloaded as a text report. The person can then open any junction and pair to check its thermodynamics and see where the primers bind on the sequence, and follow a link to check specificity in an external tool.

task.text: Design and rank PCR primer pairs whose products span exon-exon junctions, and pick the best pair to order.

data.text: A genomic nucleotide sequence where letter case marks exons and introns, and a table of candidate primer pairs with their computed properties.
data.item: a candidate primer pair designed across one exon-exon junction

stage.text: designing primers for an RT-PCR assay, before ordering and running it

mechanism.text: Sidebar constraints and a paste box feed a design run over every junction. The run fills a ranked table of all pairs and a top-recommendation card with a report download. A junction selector and a pair selector open one pair's dimer metrics and a sequence map with its binding sites highlighted.

field.text: exon-junction primer design for RT-PCR in molecular biology

workflow.name: generate candidates under constraints, rank them, and pick the best

steps.here: Paste a FASTA sequence with exons in uppercase and introns in lowercase. Header lines are dropped.

steps.step: set the constraints the result must meet
steps.here: Sidebar sliders and number fields set how many pairs to find per junction, the optimal, minimum and maximum primer size and Tm, and the product size range.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: 'Analyze All Junctions' finds every intron-to-exon boundary in the spliced template. It runs primer3 with each junction as the target and keeps the junctions that return pairs.

steps.step: rank every candidate and recommend the best
steps.here: All pairs are sorted by penalty score, then by cross-dimer ΔG, into a global table. The top pair is shown as a card with Tm, GC and self-dimer ΔG.
Choose a junction, then a pair, to see each primer's Tm, GC and self-dimer ΔG, plus product size and cross-dimer ΔG with Low/High Risk flags.

steps.step: see where the item sits in the whole
steps.here: The genomic sequence is drawn with the forward primer's binding site in yellow and the reverse complement's site in cyan, mapped back from the spliced transcript.
Download a plain-text summary report of the top pair. A sidebar button links out to Primer-BLAST to check specificity.

distinctive: Letter case in the pasted sequence carries the exon/intron structure, so junctions are found from case changes alone.
Every candidate must span an exon-exon junction, so genomic DNA cannot be amplified.
Self- and cross-dimer free energies are computed for each pair and flagged as high risk below a fixed threshold.
Binding sites found on the spliced transcript are mapped back onto the full genomic sequence, showing the reverse primer as its reverse complement.
Specificity is checked outside the tool, through a link to an external primer BLAST service.

parts.title: Primer settings sidebar
parts.summary: Sets the number of pairs per junction and the size, Tm and product-size limits for the design, and links out to Primer-BLAST for validation.

parts.title: Designer tab
parts.summary: The main tab that holds the sequence input, the ranked results, the pair detail and the binding map, next to a help tab.

parts.title: Sequence paste box and junction analysis
parts.summary: Takes the case-marked sequence, finds every exon-exon junction and runs primer3 to design pairs across each one.

parts.title: Global junction evaluation table
parts.summary: Lists every candidate pair from every junction, ranked by penalty score and then cross-dimer ΔG, with a guide to the terms.

parts.title: Top recommendation card and report download
parts.summary: Shows the best-ranked pair's sequences, Tm, GC and self-dimer ΔG, and offers it as a downloadable text report with risk statuses.

parts.title: Junction-specific pair analysis
parts.summary: Lets the person choose a junction and a pair, then shows each primer's Tm, GC, self-dimer ΔG and the pair's product size and cross-dimer risk.

parts.title: Transcript-level primer binding map
parts.summary: Draws the full genomic sequence with the selected pair's forward and reverse binding sites highlighted in two colours, mapped from the spliced transcript.
